design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 0 of provider_network_services (Takahashi Family Dentistry PLLC, DHMO primary care dentist agreement ending 2026-12-31). Revision 2 (rework round 2).

STEP 0 DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 0): {"task": 0, "key": "env_0070_dental_and_vision_benefits_carrier/provider_network_services/0", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 6]}. provider_ext_capitation_continuation 6, provider_ext_exit_settlement 6, provider_ext_repayment_interest 5; 2 prerequisite problems, 1 value_input edge (>= max(2-1,1)).

REVISION LOG (round 2): S1 — symptom: the practice's staff list-bill billing account breached the billing entry gate (customer_type employer_group); change: the billing rows were removed and the cross-category evidence moved to the practice's own Cascade employer group contract (group.yaml has no customer_type gate) in status applied with its census report, the only state that charter can produce for a provider_practice profile without a billing account; the capitation premium-standing factor became the capitation small-practice relief (staff headcount on the latest census), and the exit base share read the withholding the latest capitation payment carries (replaced in round 3 by a dispute-decision count, see below). S2 — every notice is now backed by the overpaid remittance on the ledger: the duplicate May/June runs for OVP75-2607-1530 and an erroneous supplemental capitation payment of whole member-months (16, 36, 27, 60 x 11.85) for each other notice; the history was moved into 2026 so no unseeded 2025 payment is implied. C1 — the capitation rule no longer defers to a retired base clause; the scoped replacement sentence states the first-withholding measure itself. C2 — the unverifiable 'no other agreement' clause left the exit scope. C4 — the four withholding policies carry one shared, scoped replacement of the offset-order and practice-level sentences naming each selection. C6 — the exit settlement is capped at the open amount of the overpayment it is recorded against. C8a — exit timing tiers are now 60/90 days, so the fall-through (91 to 120 days, reachable for a 90-day notice given early in a month) is a real case. C9 — combination sentences no longer name factor quantities. P1 — every stated equation is now generated from the ledger and asserted equal to the recomputation.

REVISION LOG (round 3): N2 — the small-practice relief no longer turns on whether the practice buys Cascade staff coverage (the round 3 payments measure is removed in round 4, see below). N4 — the base exit recovery share no longer reads the capitation withholding: it is set by the agreement's dispute decisions of the last 24 whole months (disputes suspend offsetting), so no exit tier is decided by another policy's factors, and the exit <- capitation edge effect is now exact (skipping the withholding raises the settlement by exactly the amount withheld: 23,976.18 vs gold). N5 (charter-wide) — a continuing capitation withholding is owed at most once per capitation payment and a continuing run withholding at most once per run, as its first entry; the first plan installment is the run's last entry. N1/N3 — coordinator ruling: the practice-held staff group contract counts for the cross-category floor in this difficulty; unchanged.

REVISION LOG (round 4): R3-N2 — the payments proxy is removed. Small-practice relief requires a documented employee headcount; the only headcount documentation Cascade holds for a practice is the census on the practice's own Cascade staff group contract, so the relief reads the latest census of that contract while it has not ended (applied or active), and a practice with no census on file, an ended contract or a larger documented headcount is on the standard terms (a stated tier, relief 0); the rule makes no same-size claim. Here the contract is applied and its latest census documents 4 employees, so the relief is unchanged. O10 — closed with the proxy: the relief sums no payments, so it cannot depend on whether the interest payment was booked first. R3-N6 / R4-N7 (charter-wide, settled in round 5) — the plan installment entry is booked like every other withholding entry (remittance component not_applicable, as the schema requires for overpayment entries), and the plan once-per-run test blocks on any withholding entry of the plan overpayment already on the run, which is the base limit of one withholding entry per overpayment per remittance; no write or figure of this task changes.

WHY IT IS A GOOD TEST: the caller only asks to settle and pay what the practice owes before it leaves the DHMO network. The figure is not a lookup: the receivable must first be brought up to date by the continuing withholding owed on today's capitation payment (a six-factor share), Cascade must first pay the interest it owes on its late repayment of an over-recovery (five factors), and only then is the exit settlement worked out from the receivable, the single capitation payment still due (members are reassigned 30 days before termination), a projection from the closed panel's trend, a recovery share set by the agreement's recent dispute decisions, tenure, balance and timing points and a haircut for competing notices. Inputs come from ledger history and from another product's records (the practice's own Cascade group contract census).

SCOPE SNAPSHOT: claimed here provider_ext_repayment_interest (pay_repayment_interest_bafa5446), provider_ext_capitation_continuation (book_capitation_withholding_57430a7a), provider_ext_exit_settlement (pay_exit_settlement_0b962b39). Task 1 claims the claim-run continuing withholding, the post-decision withholding, the plan down payment and the plan installment. Disjoint; together all seven.

POLICIES AND OVERWRITES: repayment interest (state_due; overwrite of the base clean-claim interest sentence, scoped to repayments of over-recoveries on capitation agreements). Capitation continuation (state_due; two overwrites of provider_agg_practice_offset: the practice-level sentence and the order-and-limit sentence, each replaced by a sentence naming the four withholdings that select differently — continuing capitation, continuing run, post-decision, plan installment — and keeping oldest-notice-first and the practice-level reach for every other offset; the capitation measure for first and continuing withholdings is stated in the replacement). Exit settlement (on_request; overwrite []).

FACTOR CARD provider_ext_repayment_interest (expected 1.26, whole-baseline fall-back 0): rep_clock_start (method): decision e8dac4f6-33dd-4bd4-aaa9-2785abffdd00 resolved 2026-07-24 after its due date 2026-07-19 -> clock from the due date, 72 days to the repayment of 2026-09-29; baseline (from the resolved date, 67 days) gives 1.15. | rep_grace (parameter): filing 2edd75d5-9b67-40da-8e9e-9a783b78bbee stated amount_miscalculated, repayment 47.40 < 100 -> 15 days; baseline 30 gives 0.93. | rep_delay_addon (parameter): 67 days from decision to repayment (>45, <=90) -> +3; baseline 0 gives 1.04. | rep_repeat_addon (parameter): claim payment remittances 65683189-2ae1-4729-955b-407eef41a539 (2026-05-06) and d20022d7-b147-4c9d-86fa-9d60329c92cb (2026-09-29) within 24 whole months -> exactly two -> +2; baseline 0 gives 1.11. | rep_minimum (parameter): agreement 61662bf8-5125-4f93-8064-515896cb7037 termination_pending -> no minimum; baseline 2.00 gives 0. | plain: rep_amt 47.40, rep_date 2026-09-29; result = RND(47.40 x (12 + 3 + 2)/100 x MX(0, 72 - 15)/365) = RND(1.2584) = 1.26, which is at least the minimum 0.

FACTOR CARD provider_ext_capitation_continuation (expected 9906.6, whole-baseline fall-back 9006.0): cap_aging_adj (method): notice 8d08ea8d-195c-498d-ace2-18cecb0eabb3 2026-07-20 -> 87 days to today less 45 = 42 days past the window (>30, <=60) -> flat +5; baseline 0 gives 9006.0. | cap_panel_relief (parameter): capitation payment 01ba94e7-3c7b-44fd-88e6-fe91295d3746 18,012.00 / 11.85 = 1,520 members >= 1500 -> 15; baseline 0 gives 12608.4. | cap_exit_accel (parameter): termination_pending, 2026-12-31 is 77 days away (<= 90) -> +25; baseline 0 gives 5403.6. | cap_tenure_relief (parameter): effective 2018-04-01 -> 102 whole months -> 10; baseline 0 gives 11707.8. | cap_notice_size (parameter): notice 37,398.60 >= 2 x 18,012.00 -> +10; baseline 0 gives 8105.4. | cap_small_practice (parameter, cross-category group): the practice's own Cascade staff group contract is applied (not ended) and its latest census reports 4 eligible employees -> documented headcount 4 (< 5) -> relief 10; with no census on file the practice is on the standard terms (relief 0); baseline 0 gives 11707.8. | plain: cap_no EFT75-2610-4530, cap_amt 18,012.00, run_withheld 0.00, case_id 8d08ea8d-195c-498d-ace2-18cecb0eabb3 (most recent withholding fdf0ae4b-20f9-4eee-976e-9defc3ea59bd), case_open 28,226.70; result = RND(MX(0, MN(28,226.70, RND(18,012.00 x MN(100, 50 + 5 - 15 + 25 - 10 + 10 - 10)/100) - 0))) = 9,906.60.

FACTOR CARD provider_ext_exit_settlement (expected 14069.58, whole-baseline fall-back 10025.1): exit_projection (method): confirmed panel request 42ef771b-214a-4336-a5c3-00fff7a70bc9 closed the panel; capitation payments of the last 3 whole months 18,557.10 / 18,343.80 / 18,012.00 average 18,304.30, latest below it -> 2 x 18,012.00 - 18,304.30 = 17,719.70; baseline (latest payment) gives 13987.74. | exit_base_share (parameter): dispute decisions 721f2025-e28a-4229-9cb7-37f709b949d9 and e8dac4f6-33dd-4bd4-aaa9-2785abffdd00 (2026-03-20, 2026-07-24) fewer than 24 whole months before today -> two -> 40 percent; baseline 50 gives 12652.01. | exit_haircut (parameter): notices d22ed6f8-61ce-46d5-8fe8-6553ed1f0fed (2026-05-27), 8d08ea8d-195c-498d-ace2-18cecb0eabb3 (2026-07-20), 16be4bce-5fbd-4a92-94f3-23bb430bd9ff (2026-10-02) fewer than 6 whole months before today -> 20 percent; baseline 0 gives 12829.2. | exit_tenure_points (parameter): 102 whole months -> +10; baseline 0 gives 15487.16. | exit_balance_points (parameter): notices of the last 12 whole months total 39,045.75 >= 2 x 18,012.00 -> -10; baseline 0 gives 12652.01. | exit_timing_points (parameter): 77 days to 2026-12-31 (> 60, <= 90) -> -5; baseline 0 gives 13360.8. | plain: receivable = 39,045.75 - 20,085.75 + 71.10 = 19,031.10; payments_left = 2 - 1 = 1; exit_case_open = 18,320.10; result = RND(MX(0, MN(18,320.10, 19,031.10 - RND(1 x 17,719.70 x MX(0, 40 + 10 - 10 - 5)/100 x 80/100)))) = 19,031.10 - 4,961.52 = 14,069.58.

NEAR-MISS RECORDS: the supplemental capitation payment of 2026-07-08 (711.00) is a capitation entry but falls outside the 3-whole-month average window (only 2026-08-15, 09-15 and 10-15 count); the older withholding of 2026-05-15 (OVP75-2603-0917) is not the most recent withholding; the older repayment of 2026-05-06 and the decision of 2026-03-20 are not the most recent ones; the refund of 2026-06-12 predates the filing of 2026-06-19, so the refund-date clock tier does not apply; OVP75-2603-0917 (2026-03-04) counts toward the 12-month balance points but not the 6-month haircut; the group census is the practice's staff headcount, not an enrolment count.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD: the capitation withholding inherits provider_evt_overpayment.refund_window_passed: notice 2026-07-20, 45 calendar days, 'The offset may start on the day after the notice date plus overpayment_refund_window_days calendar days' — 2026-09-03 barred, 2026-09-04 first permitted day, 2026-10-15 passes; no dispute of OVP75-2607-1530. The gate script treats the gate as retired difficulty-wide because the plan-installment policy's scoped overwrites quote its sentences, so temporal_feasibility is empty; the evidence stays in base_preconditions and the replacement sentences keep the window in force for every withholding but a plan installment. provider_agg_practice_offset, provider_evt_remittance and the refund side of provider_evt_overpayment have no gates for these writes (policy_scope recorded).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: agreement 61662bf8-5125-4f93-8064-515896cb7037 is the practice's only agreement. Overpayment under recovery OVP75-2607-1530 (8d08ea8d-195c-498d-ace2-18cecb0eabb3) = duplicate runs EFT75-2605-4471 (18,723.00) + EFT75-2606-4486 (18,675.60) = 37,398.60, first withheld 9,171.90 from the 2026-09-15 payment at the standard 50 percent of 18,343.80. Capitation payment withheld from today: EFT75-2610-4530, 18,012.00. Repayment EFT75-2609-6604, 47.40, gives back the over-recovery on OVP75-2605-1186 (refund 319.95, decision upheld 272.55, reduction 47.40). Settled by their own ledger arithmetic: OVP75-2602-0342 (refund 189.60 + reduction 23.70 - repayment 23.70), OVP75-2603-0917 (withheld in full 2026-05-15), OVP75-2605-1186. The exit settlement is booked against OVP75-2607-1530, open 18,320.10 after today's withholding.

SEED ROWS AND WHY EACH EXISTS: 10 monthly capitation payments (members 1,592 -> 1,520 at 11.85), the 2 duplicate runs and 4 erroneous supplemental capitation payments (the overpaid remittance behind every notice), 2 claim-payment repayments (count 2 drives the repeat add-on), 5 notices with their refunds, reductions and withholdings, 4 dispute rows, 2 confirmed requests (panel closure, termination notice), and the practice's applied staff group contract with its 2026-10-05 census (4 eligible employees). Removing the census sends the small-practice relief to its fall-through (withholding +1,801.20 room); removing the panel request sends the projection to the latest payment. Automatic clauses: every notice within the 545-day lookback and above 25.00; no dispute pending; credentials current (recredentialing due 2027-03-08, liability to 2027-02-28); the group contract is applied with effective date 2027-01-01, so no premium, enrolment or billing account exists for it yet (the billing charter offers a provider_practice profile no arrangement).

PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root provider_ext_exit_settlement (owner user, the practice's own money). Edge 1 -> capitation continuation, value_input, gate 'recovered', state form: 'An exit settlement is fixed only after the latest capitation payment carries the continuing capitation withholding owed on the overpayment under recovery.' ('only after'; record-visible withholding entry on the latest capitation payment; no tool or code token; only the continuing capitation withholding books against a capitation payment in this difficulty). Edge 2 -> repayment interest, state_gate, gate provider_payment_events.remittance_component, state form: 'An exit settlement is not fixed until the records carry a prompt-pay interest payment for the agreement's latest repayment of an over-recovery.' ('not ... until'; a prompt_pay_interest remittance for the latest repayment; only the repayment-interest write creates one). Opening falsity: EFT75-2610-4530 has no withholding; no prompt_pay_interest remittance exists. Order: interest, withholding (commuting, proved), settlement. Deletion sensitivity: Skipping today's capitation withholding leaves the receivable at 28,937.70; the exit settlement becomes 23,976.18 instead of 14,069.58, exactly 9,906.60 (the withholding) higher, because no other input of the settlement reads that withholding, and the withholding entry is missing. / Skipping the interest payment leaves the settlement figure at 14,069.58 but the terminal ledger lacks the prompt_pay_interest remittance, and under the rule the settlement may not be fixed while that interest is unpaid. user_scenario names no prerequisite; the tools validate none.

PERSONA DESIGN: Wendell Sato opens with the surface goal, gives the provider number, phone and tax-ID digits only when asked, describes the notices and the practice's January staff plan application only when asked, agrees passively to anything Cascade must do first, pays exactly the stated amount against the stated notice when handed the payment step, and ends.

STANDARD SOLUTION: find_customers(PN75-41826) -> verify (4255550142, 5318) -> read agreement, ledger, disputes, requests, the staff group contract and its census -> pay repayment interest 1.26 -> book capitation withholding 9,906.60 against EFT75-2610-4530 for OVP75-2607-1530 -> hand over the exit settlement 14,069.58 against OVP75-2607-1530.

VERIFICATION RUN (scratch simulator over check_compute.build_env/eval_compute and the real tools, handling-time worlds): interest 1.26 {'rep_clock_start': 1.15, 'rep_grace': 0.93, 'rep_delay_addon': 1.04, 'rep_repeat_addon': 1.11, 'rep_minimum': 0, '__all__': 0}; withholding 9906.6 {'cap_aging_adj': 9006.0, 'cap_panel_relief': 12608.4, 'cap_exit_accel': 5403.6, 'cap_tenure_relief': 11707.8, 'cap_notice_size': 8105.4, 'cap_small_practice': 11707.8, '__all__': 9006.0}; settlement 14069.58 {'exit_projection': 13987.74, 'exit_base_share': 12652.01, 'exit_haircut': 12829.2, 'exit_tenure_points': 15487.16, 'exit_balance_points': 12652.01, 'exit_timing_points': 13360.8, '__all__': 10025.1}; swapped prerequisite order gives the same three figures; settlement without the withholding 23976.18.

DECOY / ABSENT-RECORD PROBES round 4 (scratch copy; interest / withholding / settlement on the gold handling-time worlds (1.26, 9906.6, 14069.58); later figures sit on the gold writes): decoy ended contract carrying a newer census of 25 -> same; older census of 25 on the live contract -> same; newer member-added event (not a census) -> same; no census on file -> (1.26, 11707.8, 14069.58) MOVED (standard terms); live contract ended -> (1.26, 11707.8, 14069.58) MOVED (standard terms); latest census documents 7 -> (1.26, 10807.2, 14069.58) MOVED (second tier); latest census documents 25 -> (1.26, 11707.8, 14069.58) MOVED (standard terms). The round 3 record probes (remittance of another agreement dated today, older dispute decision, newer pending dispute filing -> same; absent dispute records, absent capitation payments -> MOVED) do not touch the census and stand. The census read takes the latest census of the practice's own not-ended contract by report date.

METHOD-SHAPE TABLE: cap_aging_adj floor(days/5) vs flat 5 vs 0 — all pairs pass (floor adds an operation; 5 never equals 0). rep_clock_start DAYS(due, repayment) vs DAYS(latest refund, repayment) vs DAYS(resolved, repayment) — anchors from different records (decision due date, refund ledger, decision date) — pass. exit_projection 2L - A vs A vs L — A adds SUM/COUNT, 2L - A adds an operation — pass.

XF SWEEP: mechanical transitive check — no factor binding reads another factor's binding and no plain binding reads a factor binding (assembly lives only in result); every compute_basis quote is verbatim in its rule; combination sentences name no factor; same-day ties, calendar days and whole months are stated per policy; every fall-through tier is reachable (capitation aging <= 30 days, exit timing 91-120 days, base share with no dispute decision in 24 months, small practice with no census on file, an ended contract or a documented headcount above 19); factor ids are not substrings of tool names; docstrings carry formats only. Trigger rule: the three events written (provider_overpayment_recouped, provider_remittance_issued, provider_overpayment_refund_received) have base triggers []. Round 3: no factor tier reads another policy's result (the exit settlement reads the capitation withholding only through the receivable); the small-practice factor is multi-source (contract status and its census; no census -> standard terms); each continuing withholding is owed at most once per payment.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT: from the published rules a solver sees the settlement's two waits, finds that today's capitation payment carries no withholding and that the late repayment carries no interest, computes the interest (clock from the due date, grace 15, rate 12+3+2), the continuing withholding (share 55) and then the settlement (one payment due, projection 17,719.70, share 40+10-10-5, haircut 20) — the gold figures; no second reading of a selection or tier was found.

GATE OUTPUTS (final run, repository root): check_extended EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK; check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK; check_compute COMPUTE OK; check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK; check_cache_diff info only. check_traceability is run by the coordinator after publication.
user_scenario:
You are Wendell Sato, the office manager at Takahashi Family Dentistry PLLC in Tacoma, calling Cascade Mutual's provider line on behalf of the practice owner, Dr. Emi Takahashi. You are organised, a little brisk, and you like to get things finished in one call. The practice gave Cascade written notice in September that it is leaving the DHMO network, and its DHMO primary care dentist agreement ends at the end of December. Dr. Takahashi has asked you to settle what the practice owes Cascade on that DHMO agreement before the practice leaves, so you open by saying that you are calling about the DHMO agreement that is ending, that the practice wants to settle what it owes Cascade on it now rather than let it drag on, and that you would like to know the amount and pay it today. You are authorised to make that payment for the practice: the practice will pay it from its operating account by electronic payment, in one go, today. You do not know how Cascade works the amount out and you do not try to guess it.

You give details only when the representative asks for them. If asked how to find the practice, you give the Cascade provider number PN75-41826. To confirm who you are, you give the practice phone number 4255550142 and, if a second detail is needed, the last four digits of the practice tax ID, 5318. If asked which agreement, it is the DHMO primary care dentist agreement for Dr. Emi Takahashi; the practice has no other Cascade agreement. If asked about overpayment notices, you remember the big one from July about capitation being paid twice and a small one that came in early October, and you say the representative will see the details better than you can. If asked whether the practice deals with Cascade in any other way, you mention that the practice applied in early October for a Cascade dental plan for its four employees, to start in January, and that is all you know about it. You cannot answer questions about Cascade's internal processes.

If the representative explains that something has to be taken care of on Cascade's side before the settlement can be worked out, you say that is fine and to go ahead. When the representative tells you the settlement amount and hands you the payment step, you make the payment for exactly the amount and the overpayment reference the representative gives you, and you read back the confirmation you receive. Once the payment is confirmed you thank the representative and end the call; you do not ask for anything else.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.provider_agreement_id: 61662bf8-5125-4f93-8064-515896cb7037. Basis: the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the network participation agreement the interest is paid under, as returned by the agreement lookup for the practice'; find_provider_agreements returns exactly one agreement. Uniqueness: the repayment EFT75-2609-6604 is booked to this agreement and the practice holds no other.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.interest_amount: 1.26. Principal = the most recent claim payment remittance on this capitation agreement, EFT75-2609-6604 of 47.40 paid 2026-09-29. Clock start: the most recent dispute decision (OVP75-2605-1186) was resolved 2026-07-24, after its due date 2026-07-19, so the clock runs from the due date: 72 days (standard from the resolved date gives 1.15). Grace: the dispute stated amount_miscalculated and the repayment is below 100, so 15 days (standard 30 gives 0.93); days held = 72 - 15 = 57. Delay add-on: 67 days from decision to repayment (more than 45, at most 90) -> +3 (standard 0 gives 1.04). Repeat add-on: two claim payment remittances within 24 whole months (2026-05-06, 2026-09-29) -> +2 (standard 0 gives 1.11). Rate 12 + 3 + 2 = 17; interest = 47.40 x 17/100 x 57/365 = 1.2584, rounded half up to 1.26. Minimum: termination_pending agreement -> none (standard 2.00 gives 0.00).

argument_uniqueness_tracing.settlement_amount: 14,069.58. Open receivable after today's withholding = notices 39,045.75 - withholdings, refunds and reductions 20,085.75 + repayments 71.10 = 19,031.10. Expected recovery = 1 x 17,719.70 x 35/100 x 80/100 = 4,961.52; settlement = 19,031.10 - 4,961.52 = 14,069.58, below the open amount 18,320.10. Standard method alone: 10,025.10.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites commute and were run both ways: interest then withholding gives 1.26 and 9,906.60; withholding then interest gives 1.26 and 9,906.60; the exit settlement is 14,069.58 either way. The interest reads the latest claim-payment remittance and the latest dispute decision, which a capitation withholding does not change; the withholding reads capitation payments and withholdings, which an interest remittance does not change.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping today's capitation withholding leaves the receivable at 28,937.70; the exit settlement becomes 23,976.18 instead of 14,069.58, exactly 9,906.60 (the withholding) higher, because no other input of the settlement reads that withholding, and the withholding entry is missing.

Skipping the interest payment leaves the settlement figure at 14,069.58 but the terminal ledger lacks the prompt_pay_interest remittance, and under the rule the settlement may not be fixed while that interest is unpaid.
